draft-payment.reason: Conflates the revoked sending permission with a replaced field: code and amount are said to replace request code and permission. The payment document identity is also lost; correct no-send wording does not repair this invented field substitution.

draft-copies.reason: Invents differentiation by explanatory fields despite required identical schemes, and changes permission to transmit to the surveyor into permission for the surveyor to prepare and accept.

draft-two-edits.reason: Reverses both independent decisions: applies canceled incoming_tag to accepted_tag replacement and cancels still-approved owner_tag to holder_tag replacement.

draft-addition.reason: Contradicts retained Region by saying the separate Area field is added instead of Region. Keeping Region in the preceding sentence does not remove the contradiction.

draft-literal.reason: Preserves both exact identifiers and forbids normalization, ё substitution and zero removal. This retains the original menu and document names without inventing changes.

draft-export.reason: Preserves manual XML machine-list export without ZIP and explicitly says fields are unselected. The sole field-selection question uses default wording but actually selects no defaults or proposed age/cost fields; the unresolved decision is preserved.

draft-sort.reason: Includes the complete correct four-element descending result -11, -11, -28, -46, the descending rule and no duplicate removal. The result is present in parentheses rather than a separately labeled result sentence.

draft-pressure.reason: Malformed JSON with unescaped newlines and repeated text, and incorrectly excludes the lower -52 boundary which the user explicitly retains.

draft-quote.reason: Preserves the quoted example and explicitly permits transmitting the manual to the reviewer. Awkward final wording still says not to delete the example; it creates no ban on transmitting the manual.

draft-display.reason: Uses delivery_ref instead of booking_ref in the interface and preserves database structure, no migration and no data transfer. Instead-of preserves replacement rather than displaying both.

draft-versions.reason: Retains full version with commission number and comments, its prohibition for the student, and shortened version with only number and allowed sending. The shared recipient remains the student; no competing recipient is introduced.

draft-reallow.reason: Explicitly allows transfer to the curator and retains group number and period. The superseded ban is not restored; the heading is broad but consistent.

draft-token.reason: Changes one-use code into a ban on repeated key acquisition and attaches the 190-second lifetime ambiguously to the key. The request forbids code reuse, not all repeated acquisition of a key; the authorization separation does not fix the scope change.

draft-answered-format.reason: Preserves manual contract-list export in ODS without automation and correctly omits resolved format questions.

draft-recipient.reason: Omits the explicit no-send limitation and no automatic choice of previous customer. The recipient question restricts choice to two assistant proposals without user agreement; saying draft and unselected does not preserve all explicit restrictions.

draft-delete-undo.reason: Deletes fax_line only and keeps home_line and work_line. Correctly respects the independent deletion cancellation.

draft-return.reason: Preserves returned-book count and hidden reader names, and excludes chairs and the other project. Does not reverse project scope or add requirements.

draft-label-colour.reason: Required exact name appears only in the heading, not the description under the frozen literal rule. Also invents preservation of content, which was not discussed; orange icon and unchanged address alone are insufficient.

draft-proposal.reason: Preserves city display, hidden phone and excluded unapproved tax-ID field. Introduces no other fields or questions.

draft-unset-lifetime.reason: Preserves single-use equipment-receipt code, excludes profile login, leaves duration unagreed and asks only that unresolved question. Does not invent 45 seconds or an indefinite lifetime.
